# Glamour Spam Remover Super simple plugin to address I niche I've yet to see in other plugins. ## AS OF PATCH 7.3 THIS FUNCTIONALITY IS BUILT INTO THE BASE GAME You can enable it by editing your chat log filters. Announcements tab -> Glamour Notifications







## Main Points Removes any messages with type "2105" that contain either "You cast a glamour." or "Glamours projected from plate ", both of which flood my chat whenever i swap to a set that has a linked glam plate ## How To Use * No configuration * No windows * Install and forget ### Activating in-game See above
